results.title: General Manager – Logistics Stockyard (Automotive)
results.description: The Job Summary The General Manager leads Petromin Logistics' stockyard as a profitable, customer-focused and technology-driven automotive logistics business. The role owns the full P&L, acquires and retains vehicle-brand accounts, and delivers reliable service across the vehicle lifecycle, driving the stockyard's launch and growth through digital operations, financial discipline and continuous improvement. Key Performance Indicators / Measures: • Revenue, operating profit and cash flow vs. the approved business plan • Customer margin, cost per vehicle and capacity utilisation • New vehicle-brand accounts won and growth of existing accounts • Customer satisfaction, retention and SLA achievement • Vehicle turnaround, dispatch reliability and PDI first-time-right • Damage, rework and claims recovery • Digital and AI use cases delivered, with measured gains in productivity, accuracy and cost • Safety, quality and business-continuity performance; team capability The KPIs listed in this JD define what the role is measured on; specific targets and weights are set and may be adjusted annually through the performance management cycle, in agreement with the line manager. Technical / Job-Specific Competencies 1 Business Plan & P&L Ownership Own the stockyard business plan, budget and P&L, and drive pricing, cost control, billing and collections, to deliver revenue, profit and cash targets. 2 Profitability & Investment Manage profitability by customer and service, cost per vehicle and break-even utilisation, and build investment cases for capacity and technology, to secure measurable returns. 3 Strategic Account Acquisition Personally lead account acquisition with Business Development, winning OEM, vehicle-brand, importer and distributor business through strong relationships and competitive proposals, to grow and diversify revenue. 4 Contracts & Account Growth Negotiate contracts and service levels with Finance and Legal, and grow existing accounts in line with operational capacity, to secure profitable, sustainable business. 5 Digital Strategy & Systems Lead the stockyard's digital strategy, integrating YMS, ERP, transport and customer systems, to give real-time vehicle visibility, accurate inventory and digital workflows. 6 AI & Automation Adoption Prioritise and implement AI and automation for capacity planning, vehicle allocation, damage detection, predictive maintenance and reporting, with Corporate IT ensuring data quality, security and responsible AI use, to lower cost and raise productivity. 7 Stockyard Launch & Operations Lead readiness, launch and daily operations across receipt, storage, stock preservation, PDI, VAS, customs coordination and dispatch, and control outsourced service performance, to run a reliable, efficient stockyard. 8 Customer Experience & SLAs Deliver customer SLAs, resolve escalations and improve turnaround, productivity and vehicle condition through standard procedures and root-cause problem-solving, to raise satisfaction and retention. 9 People Leadership Develop accountable managers and digitally capable teams, and align workforce capacity and shared-service levels with business needs, to deliver the business plan. 10 Safety, Quality & Governance Own safety, quality, vehicle custody and business continuity, oversee damage prevention and claims recovery, and strengthen the Integrated Management System, reporting performance and risks to the CEO, to protect people, vehicles and the business. The Job Profile 1 Educational Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. 2 Professional Certifications No mandatory certification. A logistics or supply chain certification (e.g., ASCM CLTD / CSCP, CILT) is an advantage. 3 Experience 15+ years of relevant experience, including 5 years in senior leadership with direct P&L accountability; Saudi or GCC experience is preferred. 4 Essential Job Pre-Requisites Strong finished-vehicle logistics experience (stockyard operations, PDI, transportation, outsourced services), including launching or substantially improving a stockyard or comparable operation. Proven personal success winning and retaining OEM, importer, distributor or major logistics accounts. Demonstrated delivery of YMS, WMS, TMS or ERP integration or comparable digital transformation, with measurable results. 5 Languages Proficiency Fluency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

results.title: General Manager – Commercial Vehicles & Heavy Equipment
results.description: A well-established and growing organization operating in the heavy vehicles and equipment sector. The company is focused on expanding its presence across trucks, buses, and related commercial solutions, while strengthening its market position, operational capabilities, and customer service offering. Job Purpose The General Manager will provide overall strategic leadership and operational direction for the business. The role will oversee sales, aftersales, and operational functions, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, increasing market share, improving profitability, and ensuring efficient business performance across all areas. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic and operational leadership across all business functions. Take full responsibility for the company’s P&L, revenue performance, profitability, and overall business results. Develop and implement business strategies for the heavy vehicles and equipment portfolio. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, key accounts, and growth market segments. Build and maintain strong relationships with government entities, fleet customers, and major corporate clients. Oversee sales and aftersales operations to ensure high service standards and customer satisfaction. Lead market positioning, pricing strategy, competitor analysis, and commercial planning. Ensure effective inventory management, supply chain coordination, and operational efficiency. Grow the aftersales business, including service contracts, spare parts sales, and maintenance programmes. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team. Qualifications and Skills Minimum 15 years of relevant experience within the heavy vehicles, trucks, buses, and equipment industry. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline. Proven experience in a senior leadership role with responsibility for full business operations and P&L. Strong understanding of the commercial vehicles and equipment business. Experience managing both sales and aftersales functions. Commercially driven, with a practical and hands-on leadership approach. Good understanding of regional market trends and customer requirements. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

results.title: Logistics Manager
results.description: JOB PURPOSE: The Logistics Manager owns the end-to-end movement, storage and delivery of goods. The role keeps vehicles, spare parts, industrial materials and commercial products flowing from supplier to customer at the right cost, quality and speed, while keeping every shipment compliant with UAE customs, free zone, transport and HSE requirements. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Freight, Import and Export Operations Manage inbound and outbound shipments by sea, air and road, including RoRo vehicle consignments, containerized and project cargo. Select, negotiate with and manage freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs brokers and haulage contractors under approved contracts and rate agreements. Oversee the full documentation chain: bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, delivery orders and customs declarations. Track shipments end to end, control demurrage, detention and storage charges, and escalate and resolve delays and claims. Customs and Regulatory Compliance Ensure all movements comply with UAE federal and emirate-level customs rules, GCC customs requirements and the specific procedures of the relevant free zone authority. Manage correct tariff classification, valuation, duty and VAT treatment, including designated zone and re-export movements, in coordination with Finance. Maintain import and export permits, vehicle conformity and type approval documentation, and any product-specific approvals required for industrial and commercial goods. Prepare the function for customs audits, free zone inspections and external reviews. Strategy and Planning Develop and deliver the annual logistics plan, budget and capacity forecast aligned to each business unit's sales and procurement plans. Design and continually improve logistics network, warehouse and transport models to reduce cost per unit and lead time. Run the sales and operations planning interface with sales, procurement and finance to align inventory, inbound schedules and delivery commitments. Transport and Fleet Plan and control own fleet and third party transport for inter-branch transfers, customer deliveries and project movements. Ensure drivers, vehicles and equipment meet RTA and other applicable licensing, roadworthiness and operating requirements. Monitor fuel, maintenance, utilisation and delivery performance, and apply route and load optimisation. Health, Safety and Environment Enforce HSE standards in warehouses, yards, loading areas and transport operations, including safe lifting, forklift and vehicle movement controls. Ensure dangerous goods are identified, labelled, stored and transported in line with applicable UAE regulations and supplier safety data. Lead incident investigation, corrective action and toolbox talks, and ensure insurance cover for cargo, stock and fleet is adequate. Financial and Commercial Management Own the logistics budget and cost per shipment, per unit and per delivery metrics, and report variances monthly. Control third party spend through tendering, contract compliance, invoice verification and service level reviews. Support landed cost accuracy and pricing decisions by providing timely, reliable logistics cost data. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering or a related field. 8 or more years of progressive logistics experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial role. Proven experience in the UAE market, including import and export procedures, customs clearance and port operations. Hands on experience with warehouse and transport management in automotive, industrial or distribution environments. Experience managing third party logistics providers, freight forwarders and contracts. Strong working knowledge of ERP systems, and advanced Excel and reporting skills.

results.title: Head of Aftersales - Commercial Vehicles & Construction Equipments | Al-Futtaim Automotive | FAMCO
results.description: Job Requisition ID: 181615 About Al-Futtaim Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations. Overview of the role: As the Head of Aftersales, you will be responsible for leading the Service, Parts, and Uptime functions across the Trucks and Construction Equipment divisions at FAMCO. Based in Dubai, this senior leadership role is critical to ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and profitability in line with company and OEM standards. Reporting to the GM Aftersales, you will drive strategic initiatives, optimize performance, and elevate the aftersales experience for our customers What you will do: Develop and implement aftersales strategies that align with business goals. Lead departmental operations across CE, Truck, and Dealer Aftersales functions. Monitor and improve P&L performance for the aftersales division. Drive growth in service and parts revenue through customer retention and market penetration. Oversee compliance with OEM warranty procedures and service quality standards. Collaborate with OEM partners and suppliers to ensure up-to-date service offerings and technical excellence. Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through effective service recovery and feedback systems. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 6+ direct reports and broader staff. Promote a high-performance culture focused on safety, accountability, and continuous improvement Required skills to be successful: Strong leadership in managing large aftersales teams across diverse business segments. Proven ability to drive operational efficiency and profitability in aftersales. Strategic planning and execution capabilities, particularly in service and parts growth. Excellent relationship management skills with OEMs and suppliers. Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills. Deep understanding of warranty management, dealership operations, and customer service KPIs. About the team: You will be part of a dynamic and experienced aftersales leadership team, reporting directly to the General Manager - Aftersales. You will lead cross-functional managers across Trucks and Construction Equipment departments, working collaboratively with sales, technical, and support teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience while meeting commercial objectives What equips you for the role: Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred). 7–10 years of experience in aftersales operations, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role. In-depth knowledge of Trucks and Construction Equipment systems and dealership networks. Proficiency in dealership management systems such as SAP. Demonstrated behavioral competencies: Integrity, Analytical Thinking, Customer Orientation, Effective Communication, Team Leadership, Planning & Organizing, and Assertiveness About Al Futtaim Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa. With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems. Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey. Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities. Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.
